name: Giant Vulture

source.note: The 2024 Giant Vulture (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block).

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.summary: Advantage on an attack against a creature with one of its conscious allies within 5 ft of it.
traits.text: The vulture has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Gouge
actions.summary: Gouges with its beak; the target is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

summary: A carrion bird that hunts in flocks and poisons with its gouging beak.
